samples.question: The diagram is an unfolded cube: the center square is initially TOP; its neighbors above, right, below, and left are the NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, and WEST faces, and the far lower square is BOTTOM. Read the roll cards from left to right: 1 pip means roll north, 2 east, 3 south, and 4 west. A north roll brings the south face to the top; an east roll brings the west face to the top (south and west are the inverse rolls). Which pip count is on TOP after every roll? Answer 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
